When on, \"Press and hold to speak\" and desktop voice input use MNN Whisper offline.\nNo Google services needed, and your audio stays on the device.\nWhisper-tiny gets about 80% of Chinese speech right, less than cloud recognition. Best when you\'re offline.
llama.cpp: Qwen2.5-3B-Q4_K_M recommended (~2 GB, good at Chinese)
MNN: Qwen-1.8B-INT8 recommended (~700 MB, 30+ tok/s with GPU)
Whisper ASR: whisper-tiny (~150 MB, about 80% accurate on Chinese)
Reference speed on Snapdragon 8 Gen 2: llama.cpp ~15 tok/s, MNN ~30 tok/s
Needs 6 GB+ RAM for 3B models, 4 GB+ for 1.8B MNN models

Known limits:
• No function calling: offline mode is chat only and can't control the device
• No vision: screenshots and images are ignored
• Lower quality than GPT-4 or Claude: best for private or offline use
